/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '40,88p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md; printf '\\n--- suspense granular section ---\\n'; rg -n \"Granular streaming|Push dynamic access down\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md; sed -n '195,295p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md"
